blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis is defined as a lateral curvature of the spine that develops during adolescence, without known cause. The condition can result in significant pain and disability, and often progresses rapidly during adolescence. The objective of this paper is to predict the progression of the condition in a temporal sequence from ages 9 to 24, as measured from a sequence of Dual X-ray Absorptiometry (DXA) scans. To this end, we train a transformer model that takes in the curve of the spine to predict curve progression. The model is trained using a large-scale synthetic dataset of spine curves and their time series, covering different curve types and different progression patterns. We show that the model is able to generalise from synthetic to real data by evaluating it on a dataset of real DXA scans covering multiple time points. We find that fine-tuning the model on real data gives a significant boost to performance. The model is able to accurately predict spine curve progression in both scoliosis and normal cases.
blocks.zh: 青少年精神病患者 脊椎硬化被定义为脊椎在青春期发育的横向曲折,没有已知的原因. 病情可能导致严重疼痛和残疾,而且往往在青春期迅速发展。 本文的目的是预测从9岁到24岁的病情在时间序列中的进展,通过双X射线增压扫描(DXA)的序列测量. 为此,我们训练一个变压器模型,在脊椎的曲线中,用来预测曲线的进化. 该模型使用脊椎曲线及其时间序列的大规模合成数据集进行训练,涵盖了不同的曲线类型和不同的进化模式. 我们显示,该模型能够通过在覆盖多个时间点的DXA真实扫描数据集上评价它,从而从合成数据到真实数据进行概括. 我们发现,在真实数据上对模型进行微调能大大提升性能. 该模型能够准确预测脊椎曲线在骨灰化和正常病例中的进展。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Scoliosis is a lateral curvature of the spine [ 13 ] while Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis is Scoliosis that presents in adolescent children without any known cause. Adolescent Scoliosis is more common in women than men and is believed to affect between 0.47 and 5.2% globally [ 7 ] . The condition is no longer screened for in the UK, and is often diagnosed late in adolescence.
blocks.zh: 脊椎侧曲(Scoliosis)是脊椎的横向曲折[13],而青少年偏执性脊椎侧曲(Scoliosis)是无任何已知原因在青春期儿童中呈现的脊椎侧曲. 青少年性硬化症在女性中比男性更为普遍,据信在全球影响范围在0.47%至5.2%之间[7]. 该病在英国不再接受筛查,常在青春期晚期确诊.

blocks.en:
Much attention has been paid to the task of automatically measuring the severity of Scoliosis using medical images [ 15 ] [ 9 ] . However, there has been little research attempting to predict the progression of disease. Fig. 1 shows two examples of the progression of Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis throughout adolescence in the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children
(ALSPAC) [ 2 ] , which is the primary dataset used in this paper.
blocks.zh:
对使用医疗图像自动测量斯科利氏症严重程度的任务给予了很大关注[15][9]. 然而,几乎没有研究试图预测疾病的进展。 图1在《父母与儿童纵向研究》中显示了青少年在整个青少年期的精神病病发展的两个例子。
(ALSPAC)[2],这是本文中使用的主要数据集.

blocks.en: (a) Longitudinal progression of a left lumbar scoliosis curve pattern, during adolescence.
blocks.zh: (a) 青少年时期左腰骨折曲线图案的纵向进展。

blocks.en: (b) Longitudinal progression of a right thoracic scoliosis curve pattern, throughout adolescence.
blocks.zh: (b) 在整个青春期,右侧胸骨硬化曲线模式的纵向发展。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Longitudinal scoliosis progression in two ALSPAC DXA imaging cohort participants with scans at ages 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, and 24 years. (a) Progression of a left lumbar curve, with development of a secondary compensatory right thoracic curve during late adolescence. (b) Progression from a mild curve at age 9 to a severe right thoracic curve by later follow-up.
blocks.zh: 图1:两组ALSPAC DXA成像参与者的纵向结晶化进展,扫描年龄分别为9、11、13、15、17和24岁。 (a) 向左转弯,在青春期后期发展二级补偿性右胸曲线。 (b) 通过以后的后续,从9岁时的温和曲线向严重的右胸曲线发展。

blocks.en: The main objective of this paper is to develop a model that can observe DXA scans at available time points for an individual, and predict the remaining time points. We have two use cases for the model: (1) predicting a single or multiple missing time points in sequences of scans to enable further research into the progression of Scoliosis; (2) predicting the next time point in a sequence of scans so clinicians can determine whether a patient is likely to require more frequent follow up or is at a high risk of rapidly progressing to severe disease status.
blocks.zh: 本文的主要目的是开发一种模型,可以在个人可用的时间点观察DXA扫描,并预测剩余的时间点. 该模型有两个使用案例:(1)预测扫描序列中单个或多个缺失的时间点,以便能够进一步研究斯科利氏病的发展过程;(2)在扫描序列中预测下一个时间点,以便临床医生能够确定患者是否可能需要更频繁的跟踪,或者是否极有可能迅速发展到严重疾病状态.

blocks.en:
As data is scarce, we design a synthetic data pipeline to simulate a variety of changes to spine curves and patterns of temporal progression. This pipeline is used to generate a large-scale training dataset, which is sufficient to train a transformer model. The model is pre-trained on this dataset by masking a random number of samples in the time series and tasking the model to predict these masked samples, conditioned on the observed samples. Following the pre-training on this large-scale synthetic dataset, the model is then fine-tuned on the far smaller real ALSPAC data.
It is evaluated on a held out test set of unseen real data from the ALSPAC study.
The primary novelty of this work lies in learning to predict the progression of the spinal shape, and thereby enable the prediction of scoliosis severity and clinically relevant phenotypes. Additionally, we designed a synthetic dataset for model pre-training that boosts performance.
blocks.zh:
由于数据稀少,我们设计了一个合成数据管道来模拟脊椎曲线和时间进化规律的各种变化. 这种管道用于生成一个大规模的训练数据集,这足以训练一个变压器模型. 该模型通过遮盖时间序列中随机数量的样本,并责成模型预测这些蒙蔽的样本,以观测到的样本为条件,在此数据集上进行预训. 在对这个大规模合成数据集进行预训后,该模型随后在更小的ALSPAC真实数据上进行了微调.
它通过ALSPAC研究的一套未见真实数据的测试加以评估。
这部作品的主要新颖之处在于学习预测脊柱形状的进化,从而能够预测骨质化的严重程度和临床相关的苯基. 此外,我们设计了一个用于模型预训练的合成数据集,以提高性能.

blocks.en: 1.1 Related Work
blocks.zh: 1.1 相关工作

blocks.en: The Cobb Angle [ 3 ] is the most common metric used to measure the severity of Scoliosis. It is obtained from a geometric construction where lines are drawn from the end plates of each vertebrae where the spine curves, and the angle between these lines is the Cobb angle. A visualisation of this is shown in Fig. 2 . It is typically measured on X-rays.
blocks.zh: Cobb Angle [3] 是用来测量Scoliosis的严重程度的最常用的度量. 其来源于几何构造,从脊椎曲线所在的每个脊椎的端板上划出线条,这些线条之间的角是科布角. 图2显示了这个图像。 通常用X光测量。

blocks.en: DXA scans have been increasingly used in Scoliosis research and treatment and have been described as being suitable for measuring Scoliosis severity and monitoring progression [ 13 ] . The DXA Scoliosis Method (DSM) is similar to the Cobb angle, but adapted for DXA scans where the end-plates of vertebrae are not always clearly visible. Instead of using the end-plates, a line is drawn to represent a perfectly straight spine. Lines are drawn from the first and last vertebrae of the Scoliotic curvature to the curve apex, and the DSM angle is measured between them. Taylor et al. proposed lower threshold of 6° to diagnose Scoliosis from DXA scans [ 13 ] . DXA scans are taken supine and this reduces the spinal curvature and DSM angle.
blocks.zh: DXA扫描器越来越多地用于斯科利氏病的研究和治疗,并被描述为适合测量斯科利氏病的严重程度和监测进展[13]. DXA Scoliosis Method(DSM)与Cobb角度类似,但适应于DXA扫描,其中脊椎末端板并不总是清晰可见. 与其使用端板,还画一条线来代表一个完全直的脊椎. 线条从斯科利奥奇曲面的第一椎和最后一椎到曲线顶端,在它们之间测量DSM角. 泰勒等人编. 提出从DXA扫描中诊断骨灰病的下限为6°[13]. DXA扫描被采取supine,这降低了脊椎曲面和DSM角度.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Comparison of scoliosis angle measurements. Left: Cobb angle measurement, where lines are drawn along the endplates of the upper and lower end vertebrae of the curve (figure from Radiopaedia.org [ 14 ] ). Right: DXA Scoliosis Method (DSM), which measures a modified Ferguson angle by first defining a “Normal Spine Line” to represent a perfectly straight spine. Lines are then drawn from the curve’s upper and lower end vertebrae to the curve apex, and the angle at the apex is measured (figure from Taylor et al., 2013 [ 13 ] ).
blocks.zh: 图2:石化角测量比较. 左侧:Cobb角度测量,沿曲线上端和下端顶端的端板绘制线条(图来自Radiopaedia.org [14]. 右:DXA Scoliosis Method(DSM),它通过首先定义一个“Normal Spine Line”来表示一个完全直的脊椎来测量一个经过修改的弗格森角. 然后从曲线的上端和下端的顶端抽到曲线顶端,并测量顶端的角(图来自泰勒等人,2013 [13]).

blocks.en:
There are multiple examples of measuring Cobb angle in X-Rays that achieve excellent results with high accuracy. An example is the Seg4Reg
method [ 10 ] , winner of MICCAI AASCE spinal curvature estimation challenge [ 11 ] , and several other examples [ 15 ] , [ 9 ] , [ 16 ] . On DXA scans, there exist several methods to compute the DSM ange including: regressing the angle from the image and segmentation masks [ 5 ] ; measuring the curvature from the spine segmentation and then transforming this into the DSM angle [ 6 ] ; and measuring the DSM angle directly by attempting to automate the DSM process by constructing triangles on the curves and then calculating the angle [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh:
在X射线中测量Cobb角有多种例子,它们以很高的精度取得优异的结果. 一个例子是Seg4Reg
方法[10], MICCAI AASCE脊柱曲面估计挑战的赢家[11], 和几个其他例子 [15], [9], [16]. 在DXA扫描中,有几种方法可以计算DSM ange,包括:从图像和分块口罩中反转角度[5];从脊椎分块中测量曲面,然后将其转化为DSM角度[6];通过在曲线上构建三角形,然后计算角度[1],通过尝试使DSM过程自动化直接测量DSM角度.

blocks.en: Attempts to determine future Cobb angle as a regression task using classical machine learning methods. Other attempts to apply more modern neural network architectures to predict progression of Scoliosis, have focused on predicting severe disease as a binary outcome [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 尝试用古典机器学习方法确定未来的科布角度作为回归任务. 其他试图应用更现代的神经网络架构来预测斯柯利氏病的发展过程的尝试,都专注于预测严重疾病作为二进制结果[8].

blocks.en: 2 Dataset: the ALSPAC study
blocks.zh: 2 数据集:ALSPAC研究

blocks.en:
The Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC) is a transgenerational cohort study that follows parents and their children over time [ 2 ] . Within the ALSPAC study, adolescent participants were scanned at ages 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, and 24 using a DXA scanner, resulting in total-body DXA scans.
Table 1 shows the summary statistics of the dataset, and
Fig. 3(a) shows the distribution of angles. As DXA scans are taken supine the DSM angle is less than a typical Cobb angle from an X-ray. For this work, a lower threshold of 16° was used for the onset of severe disease status. We believe this is equivalent to the commonly used 25° X-Ray, Cobb angle based, threshold used for disease which requires increased monitoring and possible bracing [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh:
父母与子女纵向研究(ALSPAC)是一项跨代群体研究,随着时间推移跟踪父母及其子女[2]。 在ALSPAC研究中,使用DXA扫描仪扫描9、11、13、15、17和24岁的青少年参与者,结果进行了全身DXA扫描。
表1显示数据集的汇总统计数据,以及
图3(a)显示了角的分布。 随着DXA扫描的进行,DSM角度小于X射线的典型Cobb角度. 在这项工作中,在出现严重疾病状态时采用了16°的较低门槛。 我们认为,这相当于常用的25°X射线、Cobb角度、用于疾病的阈值,这需要增加监测,并可能提出[8]。

blocks.en: Table 1 : ALSPAC scan distribution for 9,121 individuals across age timepoints. The top panel shows the number of participants scanned at ages 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, and 24 years. The bottom panel shows the number of individuals with N missing timepoints due to missed appointments or loss to follow-up.
blocks.zh: 表1:ALSPAC对9,121名年龄点个人的扫描分布。 顶部面板显示9、11、13、15、17和24岁年龄段的参与者人数。 底板小组显示因未能获得任命或因后续行动而失去时间点而缺少N的人数。

blocks.en: (a) Distribution of DSM and Cobb angles in the ALSPAC dataset. Larger angles are uncommon but represent more severe scoliosis. The x-axis is clipped at 25°, although DSM angles greater than 25°are present in the dataset.
blocks.zh: (a) ALSPAC数据集中DSM和Cobb角度的分布。 较大的角不常见,但代表更严重的石化. x轴在25°处被剪辑,尽管数据集中DSM角度大于25°are.

blocks.en: (b) Longitudinal angle sequences can be visualised by connecting measurements across timepoints, illustrating progression patterns within clusters of individuals. AIS cases with angles above 16° are shown for illustrative purposes.
blocks.zh: (b) 纵向角度序列可以通过连接跨时间点的测量,说明个体集群内的进展模式来进行视像。 显示角度高于16°的AIS病例以示说明。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of scoliosis angle distributions and progression sequences.
blocks.zh: 图3:斜角分布和进化序列概述.

blocks.en: Sequences can be visualised to show the overall direction of progression in individuals, see Fig. 3(b) . In individuals with a scan above 16° most individuals increase gradually or do not progress to severe disease rapidly, however, a small minority of individuals progress rapidly to severe disease.
blocks.zh: 序列可以直观地显示个人进步的总方向,见图3(b)。 在扫描度超过16°的个人中,大多数个人逐渐增加或不迅速发展到严重疾病,但少数个人迅速发展到严重疾病。

blocks.en: Real evaluation data.
blocks.zh: 真正的评价数据。

blocks.en: The ALSPAC dataset contains DXA scans from 9121 individuals. For the evaluation of the model, a randomly sampled subset of 50% of the 9121 individuals, obtaining 4561 individuals with 16,708 DXA scans, ensuring that this subset is well-stratified by severity. 8 participants that had surgical interventions have been censored across all sets, right censoring was used at the timepoint surgery was first recognised. It is possible that some individuals may have been treated with non-surgical bracing during their follow-up period, however we do not have access to this information.
blocks.zh: ALSPAC数据集包含来自9121个人的DXA扫描. 在模型评价中,随机抽取了9121个个体的50%的子集,获得了4561个个体的16,708个DXA扫描,确保该子集按严重程度得到很好的确认. 8名曾进行外科手术的参与者在所有手术中受到审查,在时间点外科手术中使用了正确的审查。 某些人可能在后续期间受到非手术性治疗,但我们无法获得这一信息。

blocks.en: 3 Learning to Predict Progression
blocks.zh: 3 学习预测进展

blocks.en: To predict the progression of Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis (AIS), we employ an encoder-only transformer. Given that the task involves measuring the progression of angles and is relatively simple, we find it feasible to generate synthetic data that mimics real distributions. The model is pre-trained on this synthetic data and evaluated zero-shot and then fine-tuned on real-data data and evaluated on a held out test set of real ALSPAC data.
blocks.zh: 为了预测青少年精神病病(AIS)的发展,我们使用一个只编码器的变压器。 鉴于这项任务涉及测量角度的进展,而且相对简单,我们认为生成模仿真实分布的合成数据是可行的. 该模型在这种合成数据上进行了预先培训,并评价了零射线,然后对真实数据进行了微调,并对一组ALSPAC真实数据进行了测试。

blocks.en: 3.1 Synthetic Data Creation
blocks.zh: 3.1 合成数据创建

blocks.en: As transformer models are prone to over fitting and the dataset of real examples is small, a large scale synthetic data is generated to train the model. The creation of the synthetic dataset is guided by the real dataset, as bounds for each curve type were observed and points were uniformly sampled from within this range to create a synthetic training dataset.
blocks.zh: 由于变压器模型容易过度安装,真实实例的数据集也很小,因此生成了大规模合成数据来训练模型. 合成数据集的创建以真实数据集为指导,因为对每种曲线类型的界限进行了观测,并且从这一范围内对点进行了统一取样,以创建合成培训数据集.

blocks.en: In the following, we describe the pipeline for generating synthetic data, which consists of sequences of spine curves. All generated curves have the same vertical extent. The real data are normalised to this same vertical length prior to input to the trained model.
blocks.zh: 下面我们描述生成合成数据的管道,它由脊椎曲线的序列组成. 所有生成的曲线都有相同的垂直范围. 真实数据在输入训练好的模型之前会正常化到同样的垂直长度.

blocks.en: First, the location of the scoliosis is sampled from the following: (1) Lumbar, (2) Thoracic, (3) Thoracolumbar, or (4) Normal examples with no significant curvature. Then, if positive for scoliosis, a left and right curve pattern was created, two examples for each region were created a single curve and a second type with compensatory curve, also known as an S-shaped curve.
blocks.zh: 一,对石化位置的采样如下: (1) Lumbar, (2) Thoracic, (3) Thoracolumbar, 或 (4) 无显著曲率的正常例子. 然后,如果对斜坡形成正向,则创建了左右曲线图案,每个区域的2个实例被创建了单曲线和带有补偿曲线的第二类型,也称为S形曲线.

blocks.en: To create a time series. A pre-defined curve is taken, T 0 T_{0} , a total rate of change is then randomly sampled from a uniform distribution and broken down into factors. The control points at the apex of the curve at T 0 T_{0} are then multiplied by their factors F 0 F_{0} to create T 1 T_{1} . At T 1 T_{1} the process is repeated until T 6 T_{6} , the final point in the time series is created.
blocks.zh: 以创时序. 取一个预定义的曲线,T 0 T_{0},一个总变化率,然后从一个统一的分布中随机抽取,细分为因子. T0 T_{0} 曲线顶端的控制点乘以它们的系数 F0 F_{0} 创建 T1 T_{1}. 在T 1 TQQQ1} 过程被重复到T 6 TQQ6}, 时间序列的最后一个点被创建.

blocks.en: To make each curve type to as realistic as possible the minimum and maximum values of the peaks for each curve type were taken from our real data and the peaks of the curves in the synthetic data was uniformly sampled within this range to provide a series of valid peaks for each curve type. This creates the x-displacement to create a 1-d curve corresponding to a specific Scoliosis phenotype. We do not believe that the distributions of synthetic and real data need to match, as this would recreate the real data’s issues with severe Scoliosis data sparsity in the synthetic data.
blocks.zh: 为了使每种曲线类型尽可能现实,从我们的真实数据中提取了每种曲线类型的峰值的最小值和最大值,并在这个范围内对合成数据中的曲线峰值进行统一取样,为每一种曲线类型提供一系列有效的峰值. 这创造了x位移,以创建一个对应特定Scoliosispheno型的1-d曲线. 我们并不认为合成数据和真实数据的分布需要相匹配,因为这会重新产生真实数据的问题,在合成数据中会出现严重的硅化数据痉挛。

blocks.en: To design each synthetic curve phenotype different subsets of eight control points were moved along the x-axis only. By moving different control points it is possible to create 1-dimensional synthetic examples of different Scoliosis phenotypes. The creation of a synthetic Left Lumbar S-curve from control points is shown in Fig. 4 .
blocks.zh: 要设计每个合成曲线的phenotype不同的子集8个控制点只沿着x轴移动. 通过移动不同的控制点,可以创建不同斯科利氏苯基的一维合成实例. 由控制点合成的左侧Lumbar S曲线在图4中显示。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Control points used to create a Double (S-shaped) synthetic curve with a primary peak in the left lumbar region (direction [left] is defined from the perspective of the participant). The synthetic curve is obtained from an interpolating cubic spline fitted through the control points.
blocks.zh: 图4:用于创建双(S-形状)合成曲线的控制点,其主峰位于左旋柱区域(方向[左]由参与者角度定义). 合成曲线是通过安装在控制点上的插图立方丝线得到的。

blocks.en:
This curve is used as a starting point for the time series of six time steps. The curve’s control points were moved in the x-axis to model progression, stabilisation or a reduction in severity of Scoliosis. Four broad progression classes were created: (1) increasing, (2) plateauing followed by increasing, (3) stable, and (4) stable decrease. At each time step the control points are moved in the x-axis to change the x displacement of the curve to create an increasing or other pattern. Overall minimum and maximum increases were captured from the ALSPAC (real) dataset. The multiplicative values for the overall change in x were uniformly sampled from a distribution between these minimum and maximum values. These are distributed among the control points as factors where their product is equal to multiplying by the total value. An example of the control points being manipulated to increase the size of a left lumbar S-shape curve is shown in
Fig. 5 .
blocks.zh:
这个曲线被用作六个时间步的时间序列的起点. 曲线的控制点在X轴上移动,以模拟进化、稳定或降低斯科利氏症的严重程度。 设立了四个广泛的进步类别:(1) 增加,(2) 稳定,然后增加,(3) 稳定,(4) 稳定减少。 每个步骤时,控制点都会在x轴中移动,以改变曲线的x位移,从而形成增量或其他模式. 从ALSPAC(实际)数据集中得到了总体的最低和最高增加。 x 整体变化的乘法值是从这些最小值和最大值之间的分布中统一抽取的。 这些产品在控制点之间分布,作为产品等于总值乘以总值的因素。 用于增加左侧立柱 S-形状曲线大小的控制点被操纵的例子如下所示:
图5

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Example synthetic curve sequences. The top row shows a continually increasing S-shaped scoliosis case, with the primary curve located in the left lumbar region and increasing throughout the full time series. The bottom row shows a scoliosis case with onset in the left lumbar region, followed by an increasing pattern that plateaus midway through the sequence. Curves are generated by shifting the peak control points along the x-axis, corresponding to lateral spine displacement, and fitting a cubic spline through the control points at each time point.
blocks.zh: 图5:示例合成曲线序列. 上行显示S形的石骨病病例不断增加,主曲线位于左侧的立柱区域,并在整个全时序列中不断增多. 下行显示左侧凸栏区域出现发作的结石化病例,随后呈现出不断增长的图案,在中途通过序列高原. 曲线是通过沿x轴移动峰值控制点产生,与横向脊椎位移相对应,并通过每个时点的控制点安装一个立方形的线条.

blocks.en: Distributions.
blocks.zh: 分发.

blocks.en: Each synthetic of the 6 timepoints has 693,289 observations. Table 2 shows counts of each of the different curve types and change patterns created in the synthetic dataset.
blocks.zh: 6个时点的每个合成器都有693,289个观测点. 表2显示合成数据集中创建的不同曲线类型和变化模式的计数.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Counts for each synthetic data class, aggregated across subclasses. Increasing curves include both gradual and delayed increases in severity, while increasing plateau curves reach their peak at different timepoints within the sequence. An additional 480,000 normal curves follow the stable pattern, with no meaningful increase in disease severity or status over time.
blocks.zh: 表2 :每个合成数据类的计数,各子类汇总. 不断增大的曲线包括轻度的逐渐增加和延迟增加,而不断增大的高原曲线则在序列的不同时点达到峰值. 另有48万个正常曲线遵循稳定规律,随着时间的推移,病情的严重程度或状况没有明显增加.

blocks.en: Split.
blocks.zh: 分开

blocks.en: For the synthetic data we use a 80:10:10 train/val/test split. Each subclass was split individually in this way and then concatenated into train, validation and test datasets. This ensured class balance between train, validation and test.
blocks.zh: 对于合成数据,我们使用80:10:10的列车/val/测试拆分. 每个子类都以这种方式单独划分,然后被压缩成列车,验证和测试数据集. 这确保了列车,验证和测试之间的等级平衡.

blocks.en: 3.2 Curve Progression Model
blocks.zh: 3.2 曲线进展模型

blocks.en:
A lightweight encoder only transformer, based on the BERT
architecture [ 4 ] , is used. The model ingests a sequence of six tokens, each representing the spine curve at one time point for an individual or a masked token if that scan is missing, and outputs a token representing the spine curve at all time points (i.e. including any that are masked). Position encoding is used to represent the time points, and is added to the input vectors to the transformer representing the curves. The masking tokens are learnt. The model consists of 2 transformer layers with 2 attention heads, the input dimension is d m ​ o ​ d ​ e ​ l = 128 d_{model}=128 , and the feedforward dimension is d f ​ f = 256 d_{ff}=256 . See Fig. 6(b) .
blocks.zh:
基于BERT的轻量级编码器
结构 [4],是使用的。 模型摄入了6个符号的序列,每个符号代表一个单个的脊椎曲线,或者如果扫描缺失一个蒙面的标志,并输出一个代表所有时点的脊椎曲线的标志(即包括任何蒙面的标志). 位置编码用于表示时间点,并加入代表曲线的变压器的输入矢量. 蒙面标志是学习的。 该型号由2个变压器层组成,有2个注意头,输入维度为dm o d e l = 128 d_{ model }=128,饲料维度为df = 256 d_{ff }=256. 见图6(b).

blocks.en: (a) The spine curve be easily decomposed into its sine series coefficients using Fourier analysis, here, using a discrete sine transform. The original signal can be reconstructed by applying an inverse of the transform and summing the resulting sine curves.
blocks.zh: (a) 脊椎曲线很容易被分解成正弦序列系数 使用Fourier分析,这里使用离散正弦变换. 最初的信号可以通过应用变换的反向来进行重建,并对由此产生的正弦曲线进行组合.

blocks.en: (b) The encoder transformer architecture used to predict missing curves (corresponding to the masked entries). The curves measured from the DXA scans are represented by a low dimensional Fourier expansion, and then mapped to the input dimension of the transformer.
blocks.zh: (b) 国家 用于预测缺失曲线的编码器变压器架构(对应蒙面条目). 从DXA扫描中测得的曲线以一个低维的Fourier扩展表示,然后映射到变压器的输入维度.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : (a) Fourier transform to sine coefficients and reconstruction from coefficients. (b) Diagram of transformer encoder architecture predicting masked coefficients.
blocks.zh: 图6:(a) Fourier从系数转变为正弦系数,并从系数中重建。 (b) 变压器编码器结构图预测遮盖系数。

blocks.en: Curve extraction & Curve Representation.
blocks.zh: 曲线提取 & 曲线表示 。

blocks.en:
A spine is segmented from a DXA scan using the segmentation network from [ 5 ] . The curve is then obtained from the midpoints of the spinal segmentation mask, producing a 2-dimensional curve.
This is rotated so that the start and end points are vertically above each other. The curve is then zero bounded and length normalized, allowing it to be represented by a compact 10 dimensional Fourier sine expansion using the method of [ 12 ] .
An example of how a spine curve can be transformed into its component sines and reconstructed is shown in Fig. 6(a) . We use this representation to provide a simplified low dimensional and slightly smoothed representation of the spine. The low-dimensional Fourier representation is used as the input to the transformer.
blocks.zh:
脊椎从DXA扫描中分解出来 使用从[5]分解网络 然后从脊柱分割罩的中点获得曲线,产生二维曲线.
这样做可以旋转,使起点和终点垂直于彼此之上. 曲线然后是零边和长度正常化的,允许它用使用[12]的方法的紧凑的10维傅里叶正弦扩展来表示.
图6(a)显示了脊椎曲线如何转化为正弦并重建其部件的例子。 我们利用这个代表来提供一种简化的低维和略平的脊椎代表. 低维的傅里叶代表作为变压器的输入.

blocks.en: Transformer input/output. The model input is a real-valued 10 coefficient sine series, see Fig. 6(a) . This is projected up to the transformer model dimension of d m ​ o ​ d ​ e ​ l = 128 d_{model}=128 for input to the model. The output of the transformer model is projected back to 10 sine coefficients using a linear layer. The sine curve can then be reconstructed.
blocks.zh: 变形器输入/输出. 模型输入是一个实际值为10系数正弦序列,参见图6(a). 这预计可达d m o d e l = 128 d _{ model }=128的变压器模型维度,以输入该模型. 变压器模型的输出利用线性层预测回10正弦系数. 然后可以重建正弦曲线.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训

blocks.en: The model was pre-trained on synthetic data to reconstruct randomly masked timepoints, masked using a learned mask token, for 500 epochs, with the best preforming checkpoint selected for evaluation. An L1 loss was used with the AdamW optimiser with an initial learning rate of 1 ​ e − 4 1e-4 and a weight decay of 1 ​ e − 4 1e-4 . Dropout was set to p = 0.1 p=0.1 . The training reconstruction loss was self-supervised. The loss was computed on the difference between the 10 sine coefficient predictions and ground truth. There are 693,289 synthetic time series that each simulate an individual in the train set, each synthetic time series had 6 time points for a total of 4,159,734 simulated time points.
blocks.zh: 该模型在合成数据上进行了预训,以重建随机遮掩的时间点,使用学习过的遮掩符进行遮掩,为500个纪元,选择了最好的预置检查点进行评估. 与AdamW Opimiser使用L1损失,初始学习率为1 e - 4 1e-4,重量衰减为1 e - 4 1e-4。 退学时设定为p=0.1 p=0.1. 培训重建的损失是自我监督的。 损失是根据10个正弦系数预测和地面真理之间的差额计算的。 共有693,289个合成时间序列,每组模拟列车编组中的单个,每组合成时间序列有6个时间点,共计4,159,734个模拟时间点.

blocks.en: The model was fine-tuned on ALSPAC using a 45:5:50 train:validation:test split, the data is split by individual so that no individual can appear across multiple sets (i.e. an individual in train will not be in test). To ensure comparability the same test set is used to evaluate the pre-trained model and after fine-tuning. To fine tune the model two losses are constructed. A similar self-supervised coefficient loss is used, although during fine-tuning an L2 loss is used and the unmasked timepoints are down weighted to ensure the loss is primarily focused on masked reconstruction on real sequences. A second L2 loss is constructed between the predicted and measured ground truth angles. These two losses are re-scaled and summed before back-propagation.
blocks.zh: 该型号在ALSPAC上进行了微调,使用45:5:50列车:验证:测试拆分,数据按个人进行拆分,以便个人不能跨多组出现(即列车中的个人不会在测试中). 为确保可比性,在评估预先训练的模型和微调后,使用相同的测试集。 为了精确调整模型 两种损失被构建。 虽然在微调时使用了L2损失,且未显示的时间点被降低加权,以确保损失主要集中于在真实序列上的蒙面重建,但采用了类似的自我监督系数损失. 第二个L2损失是在预测和测量的地面真实角度之间构造的。 这两笔损失在反向传播之前再作调整和汇总.

blocks.en: Augmentations.
blocks.zh: 增减.

blocks.en: The models were trained using a 1 dimensional Gaussian noise augmentation during training. Gaussian augmentation added high frequency noise the the curve before transformation into the Fourier domain. A 1-d dimensional Gaussian noise augmentation is also used during fine-tuning to reduce over-fitting.
blocks.zh: 这些模型在训练期间使用1维高斯噪声增强法进行训练. 高斯增强在变换成傅里叶域前增加了高频噪声. 在微调时也使用1-d维的高斯噪声增强来降低超合.

blocks.en: 3.4 DSM Angle Regression Network
blocks.zh: 3.4 DSM系统 角度递归网络

blocks.en: To measure the DSM angle we use an angle regression network. The network inputs the low-dimensional Fourier representation (that are used as the input and output of the transformer encoder model). In [ 12 ] , it was shown that the low-dimensional Fourier representation can be fed into a small MLP to reliably and accurately estimate Scoliosis and the associated phenotypes. Therefore we have designed a similar network to regress the DSM angle from the Fourier representation.
blocks.zh: 为了测量DSM角度,我们使用一个角度回归网络. 网络输入低维的Fourier代表(用作变压器编码器模型的输入和输出). 在[12]中,显示低维的傅里叶代表物可以被反馈到一个小的MLP中,以可靠和准确地估计斯科利氏症和相关的苯基. 因此,我们设计了一个类似的网络,使DSM的角度从傅里叶代表倒置。

blocks.en: The Angle Regression network is a minimally adapted version of the network from [ 12 ] , consisting of a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) with an input size of 10 to match the Fourier representation, and 5 linear layers of hidden width 64 with ReLU non-linear activation functions between each layer. The model is fitted with a regression head instead of classification heads.
blocks.zh: Angle Reression network是从[12]开始的最小改编的网络版本,由多Layer Perceptron(MLP)组成,输入大小为10,与傅里叶代表物相匹配,5个线性层的隐藏宽度64,每个层之间具有ReLU非线性激活功能. 该型号装有回归头而非分类头.

blocks.en: The angle regression network was trained on annotated ALSPAC and UK Biobank data and evaluated on the ALSPAC dataset. An evaluation on ALSPAC data previously unseen by the network is shown in Fig. 7 . The regression network exhibits excellent results when tested on real-world data with a test MAE, of 1.62°  and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 19.28% and a Pearson’s correlation coefficient of 0.80, which is comparable to [ 6 ] which reports a Pearson’s of 0.82 with an MAE of 1.9°. Due to having limited annotated ground truth, the regression network is trained on a separate 80:10:10 split of the ALSPAC data, using additional UK Biobank data in the train set.
blocks.zh: 角度回归网络接受了附加说明的ALSPAC和英国生物银行数据的培训,并在ALSPAC数据集上进行了评估。 对ALSPAC数据的评价在Fig中显示。 7 (英语). 回归网络在现实世界数据上测试后显示的优异成果是:测试MAE为1.62°,平均绝对误差为19.28%,Pearson的关联系数为0.80,与报告Pearson的0.82,MAE为1.9°的[6]相当。 由于附加注释的地面真相有限,回归网络在单独的80:10:10分解ALSPAC数据上接受了训练,在列车集中采用了额外的UK Biobank数据.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Evaluation of the angle regression network. The network showed excellent performance on real-world ground-truth angles annotated by expert clinicians specialising in scoliosis management and treatment. Left: normal, non-scoliotic cases with ground-truth DSM angles < 6 <6 ° (orange). Measured angles (blue).
blocks.zh: 图7:角度回归网络评价. 该网络在现实世界的地面-真相角度上表现出出色的表现,专家临床医生对骨质疏松症管理和治疗作了说明。 左侧:地面真伪DSM角度 < 6 < 6 °(橙色)的普通非斜体病例。 测量角(蓝).

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: The curve progression model is tested on previously unseen testing data reserved from the synthetic dataset and also on held out test set of the real ALSPAC dataset. In the synthetic data 10% of the data was reserved for testing.
blocks.zh: 曲线进化模型在以前未见的测试数据上进行测试,从合成数据集保留的测试数据上进行测试,在真实ALSPAC数据集的测试中进行测试。 在合成数据中,10%的数据被保留用于测试.

blocks.en: Both the synthetic and real data is comprised of six scans. The synthetic data is created with no missing time points. However, as the ALSPAC data is from a real-world cohort study, participants frequently missed appointments so the majority of individuals have less than six time points. This increases the difficulty of the task as it obscures important information, missing time points in different areas can also affect the difficulty of the task, i.e. a single missing time point immediately preceding the predicted time point could impede next time point prediction much more than a missing time point earlier in the sequence.
blocks.zh: 合成数据和真实数据均由六次扫描组成。 合成数据是在没有缺失时间点的情况下创建的. 但是,由于ALSPAC的数据来自现实世界的组群研究,参与者经常错过预约,所以大多数个人的时间点不到六个。 这增加了任务的难度,因为它模糊了重要的信息,不同领域的缺失时间点也会影响任务的难度,即,在预测时间点之前的单个缺失时间点会阻碍下一个时间点的预测,远远超出序列中较早时缺失的时间点.

blocks.en: Performance has been tested on two tasks: (1) Interpolating a single masked time point at age 15, where all other time points are visible; (2) Extrapolating to predict the next time point at ages 15, 17 and 24, where all future time points are masked, to prevent the model of from looking ahead, e.g. predicting masked time at age 15 from unmasked time points at ages 9, 11 & 13, where time points at age 17 & 24 are also masked.
blocks.zh: 性能在两项任务上进行了测试:(1)将15岁时的单个蒙面时间点组织起来,其他所有时间点都可见;(2)外推预测15岁,17岁和24岁时的下一个时间点,未来所有时间点都蒙面,防止模式向前看,例如从9岁,11岁和13岁时的未蒙面时间点预测15岁时的蒙面时间,17岁和24岁时的时点也蒙面.

blocks.en: The metric used to measure the success of reconstruction tasks is the proportion of predictions within two, three, four and five degrees of the target angle. This is a threshold accuracy metric, where the accuracy shows the proportion of predictions within n n ° of the target.
blocks.zh: 用于衡量重建任务成功与否的尺度是目标角度的2,3,4和5度范围内的预测比例. 这是一个阈值精确度的度量,其精确度显示目标n°以内预测的比例.

blocks.en: 4.1 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.1 基线

blocks.en: For all experiments we construct simple baselines, these fully reconstruct the curve and allow all curves the angle to be measured by the same frozen DSM angle regression network. For both experiments we construct a baseline in the curve space and in PCA space. PCA space baselines are reconstructed into curves before angles are measured.
blocks.zh: 对于我们构造的简单基线的所有实验,这些都完全重建了曲线,并使得所有曲线的角度都能够通过相同的冷冻DSM角度回归网络来测量. 对于这两个实验,我们在曲线空间和五氯苯甲醚空间构建基线。 五氯苯甲醚空间基线在测量角度之前重建成曲线。

blocks.en: Interpolating the curves. The masked curve is reconstructed using an inverse age-distance linear interpolation of the observed curves, a multiplier is used to represent distance from the target in age, ensuring curves closer to the target contribute more to the reconstruction: 𝐱 𝐭 ∗ = ∑ i λ ~ i ​ 𝐱 t i , λ ~ i = λ i ∑ λ i ​ … ​ n , λ i = 1 | age t ∗ − age t i | \mathbf{x_{t^{*}}}=\sum_{i}\tilde{\lambda}_{i}\,\mathbf{x}_{t_{i}},\tilde{\lambda}_{i}=\frac{\lambda_{i}}{\sum\lambda_{i...n}},\lambda_{i}=\frac{1}{\lvert\mathrm{age}_{t^{*}}-\mathrm{age}_{t_{i}}\rvert} where x t i x_{t_{i}} is the observed curve at age t i t_{i} , t ∗ t^{*} is the masked timepoint, and the sum runs over all observed timepoints. This is done in both curve and PCA space to provide two interpolation baselines.

Extrapolating the curves. An SVD is used to reduce the dimensionality of the observed curves of a sequence: either raw coordinates in curves space or projected PCA space coefficients. A linear regression is then fitted to the remaining points, yielding a centroid c and unit direction v. Each observed point is projected to give its position along v. A per-year rate is estimated by linearly regressing these positions against age. The forecast is then obtained by sampling the at the next age-timepoint: stepping along v from the fitted positions by the per-year rate times the age gap. This is computed in both curve space and PCA space to provide two baselines.
blocks.zh: 外推曲线. 使用SVD来降低一个序列中观测到的曲线的维度:要么是曲线空间中的原始坐标,要么是预测的PCA空间系数. 然后将线性回归加到其余点上,得出一个中间体 c 和单元方向 v. 每个观测到的点预计会给出其位置。 估计每年的比率是通过这些职位逐年递减。 然后通过在下一个年龄点取样得出预测:按年率乘以年龄差距,从合适的位置走出来。 这在曲线空间和五氯苯甲醚空间中计算,以提供两个基线。

blocks.en: Principal component analysis (PCA). The curves were represented in a principal-component basis learned from all timepoints of the ALSPAC (real data) training curves, with K = 10 K=10 components. The first K = 10 K=10 components retain 99.5 % 99.5\% of the variance. After this, the PCA basis was applied to the test set for evaluation. The observed curves of a sequence are projected into the principal-component subspace.
blocks.zh: 主要组成部分分析。 从ALSPAC(真实数据)训练曲线的所有时间点学到的曲线以主要组成部分为基础表示,K=10K=10个组成部分。 第一个K = 10 K = 10组件保留了99.5%的差额。 在此之后,将常设仲裁法院的基础适用于一套评价测试。 一个序列的观测曲线被投射到主组件子空间.

blocks.en:
Training Only on ALSPAC Data. To determine if pre-training on the synthetic
dataset aides performance we trained the model only on the ALSPAC dataset.
blocks.zh:
只对ALSPAC数据进行培训。 确定是否对合成人进行预训
我们只在ALSPAC数据集上训练模型

blocks.en: 4.2 Interpolation results
blocks.zh: 4.2 内插结果

blocks.en: Table 3 : Interpolation. Predicting masked time points within the sequences of scans. Methods: Linear Interpolation, PCA Interpolation (PCA), trained on ALSPAC data only (ALSPAC Train), pre-trained model (Pre-train), and fine-tuned on ALSPAC (Fine-Tune). Everything is evaluated on the ALSPAC test set.
blocks.zh: 表3:内插情况。 在扫描序列中预示蒙蔽的时间点. 方法:线性国际化,五氯苯甲醚国际化(PCA),只接受ALSPAC数据培训(ALSPAC列车),预训模式(预训),在ALSPAC(Fine-Tune)上进行微调. ALSPAC测试集对每样东西都进行了评估.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Single masked time point prediction with 4 unmasked time points at 11, 13 17 and 24 (green dotted) to predict masked time point 15 (red dashed). The scan at age 9 is missing but the network is still able to predict accurately.
blocks.zh: 图8:单面蒙蔽时间点预测,在11,13 17和24时有4个未蒙蔽的时间点(绿色点)来预测蒙蔽的时间点15(红色破碎). 9岁时扫描缺失,但网络仍然能够准确预测.

blocks.en: The model’s ability to predict missing time points within a sequence of six scans has been tested by the age 15 masked time point. The other timepoints in the time series are unmasked and 1 is masked and is predicted. The results of predictions are shown for errors within 2°, 3°, 4° & 5° in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 该模型在六次扫描的序列中预测缺失时间点的能力,已经通过15岁时的蒙蔽时间点进行了测试. 时间序列中的其他时间点被解码,1被蒙蔽并被预测. 表3显示2°、3°、4°和5°范围内的错误预测结果。

blocks.en: The model shows good results on interpolating a single masked time point at age 15, the angle is predicted within 5° in the vast majority of cases across and with high accuracy at 2°, 3°, and 4°. The baselines outperform the models in the non-case category as there is minimal change in the 0-6° non-scoliosis participants, so the baselines excel at predicting where there is little or no change across the timeseries of scans. Participants with smaller DSM angles are less likely to progress to severe disease, so represent an easier task. Across all other disease severities (all patients who have Scoliosis). The model trained on ALSPAC data only, does well across most interpolation tasks often out-preforming the simple baselines and has comparable results with the models pre-trained on synthetic data. The results beat the baselines for the interpolation task, and fine-tuning the model improves performance compared to the model that is pre-trained (only) across both the 2° threshold and the 5° threshold, showing fine-tuning makes the model more accurate and more consistent. An example of a interpolation prediction is shown in Fig. 8 .
blocks.zh: 该模型显示在15岁时插入单个蒙面时间点时有良好结果,在绝大多数跨度,3°,4°的病例中,角在5°以内,并且精度较高. 基线在非个案类别中优于模型,因为0-6°非斜化参与者的变化最小,因此基线在预测扫描时间序列中变化不大或没有变化的地方方面优异。 具有较小的DSM角度的参与者不太可能发展到严重疾病,因此是一个比较容易的任务. 在所有其它疾病间断(所有患有骨质疏松症的患者)中. 仅对ALSPAC数据进行训练的模型,在大多数插值任务中表现良好,往往超过简单的基线,与预先对合成数据进行训练的模型具有可比较的结果. 结果击败了内插任务的基线,与2°阈值和5°阈值的预训(仅)模型相比,对模型的微调提高了性能,显示微调使模型更加准确,更加一致. 图8显示了插值预测的例子。

blocks.en: The task of predicting the next time point is important for clinical practice. The severity of Scoliosis can be measured automatically but for monitoring progression, it is preferable to know whether an individual is at risk of severe disease before they experience it. The next time point has been masked along with all subsequent time points, to ensure there is no visibility of the later time steps.
blocks.zh: 预测下一个时间点的任务对于临床实践很重要. 可以自动衡量病情的严重程度,但为了监测进展,最好在一个人经历严重疾病之前,先知道他是否面临严重疾病的风险。 下一个时间点和随后的所有时间点都被掩盖,以确保以后的时间步骤没有可见度.

blocks.en: The next time point is predicted and measured against the ground truth. The model was pre-trained on synthetic data and has been evaluated on real data: after pre-training and again after fine-tuning, the results are shown in table 4 . In the predicting the next timepoint task we show good results performing well against the baseline, our method shows more robust results, being able to predict complex patterns of increase, allowing for generalisable predictions. Predicting the next time point with good accuracy across a range of Scoliosis severities. Whilst occasionally getting good results in some bands, the PCA baseline struggles to preform reliably across all bands occasionally failing to estimate the next time point within a 5 degrees from the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 下一个时间点是根据地面真相预测和衡量的。 该模型在合成数据方面进行了预先培训,并在实际数据方面进行了评估:经过预先培训,在微调后,结果见表4。 在预测下一个时间点任务时,我们显示在基线方面表现良好,我们的方法显示更强劲的结果,能够预测复杂的增长规律,从而能够作出一般性的预测。 精确地预测下一个时间点 跨越一系列的石化断裂 虽然在某些频段偶尔会取得良好结果,但常设仲裁法院的基线却难以在所有频段中可靠地预先形成,有时无法在距地面真相5度之内估计下一个时间点。

blocks.en:
The model trained only on ALSPAC data, preforms well extrapolating 0-6° angles but does not preform as well as the pre-trained models on the more complex moderate and severe cases, this is likely because severe scoliosis is rare in the real-world data and this model has struggled to learn these more complex increase patterns. The pre-trained model preforms well, fine-tuning increases the accuracy of the results and also improves the consistency, generalisability and robustness of the model, improving the quality of predictions across ages 15, 17 and 24. An example of a next timepoint prediction is shown in
Fig. 9 .
blocks.zh:
该模型只接受了ALSPAC数据的培训,预示了0-6°角度的很好推断,但并没有预示以及更复杂的中度和重度病例的预训模型,这可能是因为严重石化在现实世界数据中是罕见的,而这一模型在学习这些更复杂的增殖规律方面一直挣扎. 预训模型预型良好,精细调整,提高了结果的准确性,也提高了模型的一致性,通性,稳健性,提高了15,17,24岁年龄段的预测质量. 下一个时间点预测的示例如下:

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We have shown that a transformer model pre-trained on synthetic data, and fine-tuned on real data can be used to predict spine curves in DXA scans of real Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis temporal sequences.
blocks.zh: 我们已经证明,一个变压器模型在合成数据上预加训练,在真实数据上进行微调,可以用来预测在DXA扫描中真实的青少年偏执症时间序列中的脊椎曲线.

blocks.en: Uses of this model include as a potential future medical device, where the next time point could be predicted and patients could be followed up more frequently if they are likely to be at risk of progression to severe disease or given earlier access to physiotherapy and non-surgical bracing interventions before severe disease occurs. Another potential use is as an advanced analytics tool to help researchers impute missing observations in medical studies, allowing researchers without a machine learning background (e.g. epidemiologists) to impute missing time points with greater precision on the likely true value. Future work will include incorporating contextual information, such as: sex, height, weight & skeletal maturity into predictions. As well as cross institute testing.
blocks.zh: 这种模式的使用包括作为一种潜在的未来医疗设备,可以预测下一个时间点,如果病人有可能发展到严重疾病,或者在严重疾病发生之前提前获得理疗和非手术性治疗,可以更经常地跟踪病人。 另一个潜在用途是作为高级分析工具,帮助研究人员在医学研究中估算缺失的观测结果,使没有机器学习背景的研究人员(如流行病学家)能够更精确地估算缺失时间点的可能真实值. 今后的工作将包括将相关信息纳入预测,如:性别、身高、体重和骨骼成熟度。 还有交叉研究所的测试
